wages.text: In an interview, Andrews called for raising the federal minimum wage, including to $15 an hour.
wages.quote: We need to raise the federal minimum wage. How long have we been having a conversation about a $15 minimum wage? And it’s beyond time to raise the federal minimum wage.

schools.text: Her campaign platform calls for investment in classrooms and full funding for public schools and special education.
schools.quote: Invest in modern classrooms, technology, and school safety

safety.text: Andrews supports increased funding for hospital and community violence intervention programs.
safety.quote: increased funding for hospital and community-based violence intervention programs

guns.text: She supports universal background checks, along with other gun safety measures.
guns.quote: We can respect the Second Amendment and still protect our kids. That means: Universal background checks

abortion.text: Her platform says she will fight to restore Roe v. Wade protections and expand reproductive health access.
abortion.quote: These decisions belong to women and families, not to politicians. I’ll fight to: Restore the protections of Roe v. Wade

cannabis.text: In a candidate questionnaire, Andrews said she supports full legalization and regulation of marijuana.
cannabis.quote: Legalization and regulation is the best way to ensure safe purchasing and consumption of marijuana.

health.text: Her platform supports a public option and expanding Medicaid and Medicare.
health.quote: Advocate for policies like a public option that expand access to affordable healthcare for all South Carolinians

voting.text: She supports accessible elections and opposes efforts that make participation harder for eligible voters.
voting.quote: I support secure, fair, and accessible elections, and I will oppose efforts that make it harder for eligible voters to participate.

safety.text: She supports police funding, training, and equipment and opposes defunding police.
safety.quote: She opposes every effort to defund the police, supports the funding, training, and equipment our officers need, and backs tough penalties for fentanyl traffickers and violent repeat offenders.

immigration.text: She supports a border wall, increased border enforcement, ending catch-and-release, and removal of criminal immigrants without legal status.
immigration.quote: Darline supports finishing the wall, fully funding border enforcement, and ending catch-and-release.

guns.text: She backed proposals expanding gun rights, including concealed-carry reciprocity and ending magazine-capacity restrictions.
guns.quote: We must ensure that law-abiding Americans can protect themselves and their loved ones without fear of prosecution. It’s my sworn duty to preserve that right.

abortion.text: She called herself pro-life, said she would not waver in that support, and co-sponsored several bills restricting abortion access.
abortion.quote: I’m proud to be pro-life and to stand up for the unborn and expecting moms. I will not waver in my support for life, pregnant women, and families.

health.text: She publicly characterized government-run health care as a bad idea.
health.quote: Gun control, government-run healthcare, abortion until the moment of birth, bad idea after bad idea, Annie Andrews backs them all.

voting.text: She co-sponsored the SAVE America Act, which requires photo ID and proof of citizenship for federal voting and calls for removing ineligible voters from rolls.
voting.quote: These reforms are common sense and need to be enacted quickly. I look forward to working closely with President Trump to get the SAVE America Act signed into law.

tax.text: She argues that raising taxes will not solve the debt problem and calls for spending reform and a simpler tax code.
tax.quote: we can’t tax our way out of this. That is not a viable “fix it” option.

abortion.text: She wrote that abortion rates need not be reduced by outlawing access to safe medical treatment.
abortion.quote: To actually reduce abortion rates, we don’t need to outlaw access to safe medical treatment.

cannabis.text: She called for decriminalizing cannabis and ending arrests for cannabis-related conduct.
cannabis.quote: Stop arresting people for growing, harvesting, selling, buying, and consuming cannabis.

health.text: She favors consumer-driven private insurance and says government should leave the health-insurance market.
health.quote: Finally, and most importantly, government needs to get out of the health insurance market.

voting.text: She said she supports voter-identification laws such as the SAVE Act while generally opposing federal mandates on states.
voting.quote: As a Libertarian, Whitener doesn’t support foreign intervention, like the actions in Iran, but does support the concepts of voter ID laws, like what can be found in the SAVE Act.
